content:
All signs point to Siri AI coming to HomePod via brand new hardware, and leaker pdfu today shared what the new Siri might look like on HomePod.

HomePod 27 code includes support for Siri AI, along with a fresh new status indicator light

Apple never talks about future products, but rumors have swirled for months now that Siri AI is coming to a new Apple TV 4K and HomePod.

When Apple unveiled Siri AI in June, the company made zero mention of the assistant coming to tvOS or HomePod. Many speculated that was because the new Siri would require as-yet-unreleased hardware to function.

Now, via a new post from leaker pdfu on X, we may be getting our first look at Siri AI running on HomePod. Here's the post and video:

As the post points out, the HomePod 27 software includes the code needed for Siri AI, it's just not enabled for users yet.

In a follow-up post, pdfu added that it's unclear if Siri AI will be limited to new hardware only, but it seems almost certain.

If Apple intended to bring Siri AI to older HomePod models, they would have surely announced that feature in June. The silence about Siri AI for the Home product strongly suggests strict hardware requirements will be in place.

What do you think of the new Siri AI design on HomePod? Let us know in the comments.
